[u][b]PROGRAMMING[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FIXED: Bug where the horse could be summoned right after Turgut and Meryem exited the cave.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Issue where the player would start in the sky after the jackal fight cinematic.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking bug allowing players to enter through the backdoor during the Shaman confrontation.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Flickering and visibility issues with Ertuğrul during the Shaman death cinematic.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Dream sequence bug where early nightmares spawned in unreachable areas and broke the game.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Final nightmare cinematic not triggering after defeating the last enemy in Ertuğrul’s dream.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Poor performance for players who previously played the demo or an older Epic Games version.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Underground spawning issue with NPCs during the mission to confront the Shaman.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Exploit where players could spam the bow using left-click.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking bug allowing Meryem to leave the Armenian village before completing the required objectives.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking bug when trying to grab barrels using right-click.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Bug causing companion NPCs to teleport suddenly when looked at.[/p][/*][*][p]FIXED: Friendly characters dying unexpectedly during the Mongol raid near the Weavery.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Added visual feedback (VFX) when poisoned by a snake bite.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Added a marker in the deer hunting mission to prevent the deer from becoming unfindable in the final stages.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[u][b]UI/UX[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FIXED: Game-breaking issue where buttons in the initial disclaimer screen did not respond.[/p][/*][*][p]IMPROVED: Added reminders for Turgut’s "Skills" and "Attributes" when starting the game with him.

notes.title: Language Support Roadmap – Updated as of June 2025
notes.content:
[p]I wanted to share our road map in the language support , as part of our ongoing efforts to make Ertuğrul of Ulukayın accessible to a global audience, we've been steadily expanding our language support across the game. 

We're currently working on synchronizing all subtitle languages between Part 1 and Part 2 for consistency. [b]Some languages will be temporarily locked until their localization is finalized and fully tested.[/b]

[/p][h2]Languages :[/h2][p]
[/p][h3]✅ Completed in Part 1 :[/h3][p]
[/p][h3]Dubbing:[/h3][p] Turkish (TR), English (ENG)

[/p][h3]Subtitles:[/h3][p] Arabic (AR), Simplified Chinese, English, French (FR), German (GER), Japanese (JPN), Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR), Russian (RU), Spanish (ES - LATAM), Turkish (TR), Urdu  [/p][h3]✅ Completed in Part 2 (as of June 2025):[/h3][p]
[/p][h3]Dubbing:[/h3][p] Turkish

[/p][h3]Subtitles:[/h3][p] Arabic, Simplified Chinese, English, Russian, Turkish


 [/p][h3][b]🎯Upcoming Goals (Target: August 2025):[/b][/h3][p]
> Make all completed translations available in both parts of the game.

> Add new subtitle options:
    [/p][list][*][p] Korean 
[/p][/*][*][p] Italian 
[/p][/*][*][p] Polish
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ertugrul of Ulukayin | Steam Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=45PqCGio-mA;full][/previewyoutube][b]

Restore Justice in the Ancient Lands[/b]

Set in the ancient lands of 13th-century Anatolia, in Ertugrul of Ulukayin players can explore a world rich in history, legend, and combat. [b]Play as Ertugrul, Turgut, and Meryem, each with unique weapons and combat styles[/b], as you battle Mongols, legendary creatures, and a secret order seeking to corrupt the land.  uncover the mystery that binds humanity’s fate to a powerful secret known as [b]“The Key of the World.”[/b]

Players can venture through a[b] semi-open world,[/b] uncovering historical landmarks, battling legendary creatures,  and experience Turkish mythology through vivid dreams, where wisdom and nightmares intertwine. The adventure extends beyond reality, offering cryptic messages and hidden clues that shape the fate of the world.
